figD1_conditional_sensitivity: CONDITIONAL SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS on saved out-of-fold predictions (not causal attribution, not a retrained model): mean-over-repeats AUC change from E01 (original cleaning) to E01c (corrected) within patient subsets defined label-free: whether any E01 feature changed between available/missing, and three groups by the mean absolute standardized feature change (zero / below / above the median of the non-zero changes). Diamond = difference; line = 95% bootstrap interval resampling patients within the subset (conditional on saved predictions). Small subsets give wide intervals; subgroup AUCs pool predictions from models trained on all patients, so differences cannot be attributed to the availability change itself.
figD2_component_evidence_example1: Example 1 (same fixed-rule recording as figure P2; ID not shown): for each component removed by v2 - time course with VEOG/HEOG (bipolar) and detected blinks; source spectrum; blink-locked average of the component and VEOG. This is documentation only; cleaning was not changed. Components marked UNRESOLVED have no blink-locked response (peak/baseline SD < 3) and weak HEOG correlation (|r| < 0.3), so their removal rests on correlation outlier + frontal topography alone and remains unverified.
